native.harness: observed_program::compare cannot be used: pinned rustc needs a `start` lang item to build a no_core `fn main` executable, and RustGM supports none. Pinned Rust therefore compiles the same native.rs as a library object and links entry.c, whose C main calls rg_observe; RustGM's executable main calls the same rg_observe.
native.backend_path: backend.py --native-object goes through cppgm++ -c and cc. This slice does not exercise standalone lowir2native; the make test-backend assembly handshake covers that path.

state_reads_rules.asm.rules.reg-not-input: Any registers not specified as inputs will contain an undefined value on entry to the assembly code.
state_reads_rules.asm.rules.x86-df: On x86, the direction flag (DF in `EFLAGS`) is clear on entry to the assembly code and must be clear on exit.

header.state_reads_tradeoff: 8|16 keeps the x87 and MXCSR control fields live into the asm, so a template may depend on the rounding and exception-mask state. The status flags hold an undefined value on entry and DF is clear, so no status or DF read is declared. The conservative 63 would also forbid the backend from moving status-flag producers across the asm.
